data.why: All curves are computed analytically in-app from sidebar-set rotation rate, density, field strengths and azimuthal order; no file inputs are read.

goals: Set the background rotation rate, solar radius, and plasma density to see how the Alfvén speed and dimensionless magnetic parameter alpha respond
Scan a range of azimuthal order m to see how the HD Rossby baseline and fast/slow magneto-Rossby branches diverge
Compare multiple magnetic field strengths B (via presets or a custom comma-separated list) to see how the slow branch departs from the HD Rossby baseline as B grows or rho shrinks
Toggle visibility of the HD Rossby, fast/slow magneto-Rossby, and Alfvén branches to isolate individual wave families on the plot
Zoom into a region of m-nu space using the axis limit sliders to inspect a particular crossing or branch separation
Export the full table of computed curves (curve family, B, m, nu) as a CSV for further analysis

review.summary: This is a careful, well-evidenced tree: its three phases match the README's flow, and every screen sampled supports its node. It needs a few fixes before filing. The open CSV question is settled by the code (the export follows the toggles), the core scientific comparison of slow branch against HD baseline should be a task, generic Streamlit chrome should be trimmed, and the legend-encoding feature should be added.
